name: Stash
description: Stash is a self-hosted organizer for adult media collections. It scans your library, then enriches it with performers, studios, tags and scene metadata pulled from stash-box instances such as StashDB and from community scrapers, and serves everything through a web interface.

notes.text: On first start Stash runs a setup wizard at http://<IP>:9999 where you pick your media directories and optionally set a username and password.
Configuration, database and generated content live in /opt/stash_data, outside the app directory, so they survive updates. Include this directory in your backups.
Media files are not stored in the container. Mount your library into the LXC (for example via a Proxmox bind mount) and point the Stash scan directories at the mount path.
